name: Exterior Soffit RRP Lead-Safe Containment
intent: EPA Lead-Safe RRP module for pre-1978 homes. Lead screening, containment setup/teardown, wet scraping protocol, HEPA vacuum. Overhead scraping is HIGH RISK for lead dust — debris falls directly onto crew.
doctrine: RRP module. Conditional on pre-1978 + positive lead test. Overhead scraping is HIGH RISK — debris falls directly onto crew, wider containment zone required (10 ft from structure). Wet scrape at 50 SF/hr (overhead wet scraping is slowest RP task). HEPA vacuum required after EVERY paint disturbance per EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745.
